title: Topometric Autonomous Vehicle Localization by Combining Visual Embeddings and Feed-Forward 3D Models
summary: Effective Visual Localization requires a map of the environment that combines compactness for efficient scalability with robustness against visual appearance changes and metric precision. The paper combines probabilistic visual place recognition with feed-forward neural 3D geometry in a topometric localization pipeline for sequential appearance-based localization.
norm_title: topometric autonomous vehicle localization by combining visual embeddings and feed forward 3d models

title: Adaptive-WAM: Quality-Guided Early-Exit Planning from Intermediate Video-Diffusion Features
summary: Large video diffusion models provide rich spatiotemporal priors for autonomous driving. Adaptive-WAM attaches trajectory diffusion heads to intermediate DiT blocks and exits early once trajectory quality is sufficient, reducing planning latency while preserving strong planning performance.
norm_title: adaptive wam quality guided early exit planning from intermediate video diffusion features

title: LoDA: A Level of Detection Aware Method and a Multimodal Sensing Benchmark for Object Level Change Detection
summary: High-definition 3D LiDAR maps are important for autonomous driving and smart-city services. The work studies multimodal object-level change detection in multi-temporal urban LiDAR for map maintenance.
norm_title: loda a level of detection aware method and a multimodal sensing benchmark for object level change detection

title: From Sports to Safety: Benchmarking Proactive Risk Inference in MLLMs
summary: The paper benchmarks proactive risk inference for multimodal LLMs, with safety-oriented scenarios relevant to physical hazard anticipation but less directly focused on the autonomous driving stack itself.
norm_title: from sports to safety benchmarking proactive risk inference in mllms

title: GAUGE: A Measurement-Grounded Benchmark for Physical Fidelity in Simulation Engines and Video World Models
summary: The work benchmarks physical fidelity in simulators and video world models, useful for embodied and driving simulation research but less directly tied to vehicle perception, planning, or control than the selected papers.
norm_title: gauge a measurement grounded benchmark for physical fidelity in simulation engines and video world models
